name: AD5B Ballistic Gatling
description:
Manufacturer: Behring
Item Type: Ballistic Gatling
Size: 5

The AD5B, Behring's take on the classic ballistic gatling, includes a crystal cycle firing mechanism in the the high speed rotary system to maximize efficiency for sustained engagements with minimal misfires. Next time an aggressor escalates a hostile situation, make them regret the decision by spinning up this overwhelming and effective weapon.
